Sam (CSM): Heads-up — Crestline's daily active users dipped ~48% this week after their new procurement lead joined. They also started a POC with RazorAI last Friday. Renewal touchpoint is in ~3 weeks.
Jamie (AM): Yikes. Which cohorts dropped? Seats or API calls?
Sam (CSM): Mostly API call volume on autocomplete & rerank routes, and two power users stopped. Seats are stable for now.
Akshay (Solutions Eng): Can we get last 30 days by route + top 10 org users? I can check for errors/latency regressions.
Sam (CSM): Pulling an initial query now — will paste results.
Raven (support-bot): Query queued: analytics/usage_summary for org_id=crestline, range=30d.
Sam (CSM): Results snapshot: total_tokens down 47.8%, autocomplete_calls down 61%, rerank_calls down 42%. 2 users with zero calls in last 7 days.
Marta (RevOps): Procurement mentioned a "feature parity" ask with RazorAI in the last call. They want better CSV export + SSO audit logs. That could explain the eval.
Jamie (AM): Ok, likely combination of stakeholder change + missing infra features. Sam — any notes from onboarding or enablement that touched those users?
Sam (CSM): Onboarded Q1, did a 2-hour enablement. Power users are in SalesOps and have heavy CSV export workflows. We didn't demo the new audit/logging roadmap.
Akshay (Solutions Eng): Quick check — no current errors or latency spikes in infra. Logs show increased 403s for one service token over the past week (prob token rotation). Could be an integration break.
Sam (CSM): Good catch. I'll ask their admin if they rotated keys.
Jamie (AM): Meanwhile, let's prep a short counterplay: 1) Ops checklist to fix token/integration 2) Export + audit workarounds (tempo doc) 3) Offer a 30-day pilot with dedicated SE hours to re-run key workflows 4) ROI one-pager for procurement.
Marta (RevOps): I can pull a tailored spend/usage trend and build the ROI slide. If they put RazorAI in a shortlist, procurement will want delta on cost and retention.
Akshay (Solutions Eng): I can offer a quick demo showing CSV export via our internal tools and propose a small script they can drop in while we prioritize a native feature. Sample snippet I can run with them:
```bash
# quick export via API (example)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/export 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"route":"autocomplete","format":"csv","range":"7d"}'
```
Sam (CSM): I'll loop in the customer admin and ask about token rotation + confirm who the new procurement lead is. Also scheduling a call for tomorrow EOD to present the short-term pilot.
Jamie (AM): Suggest offering 2 dedicated SE hours + success playbook during pilot. If they accept, we can convert their momentum into a technical win before procurement decision.
Marta (RevOps): If they push for discounts, propose a time-limited credit tied to active usage and a quick SLA on export/audit work. I'll draft language.
Akshay (Solutions Eng): If we can show zero-setup export workaround and fix the token issue, that removes 70% of their blockers. Happy to run the session.
Sam (CSM): Great. Action items: Sam — confirm token/admin + schedule EOD call; Akshay — prepare demo snippet + troubleshooting steps; Marta — ROI slide + discount language; Jamie — lead the procurement thread on the call.
Raven (support-bot): Reminder: scheduled call created — Crestline / Redwood — 2026-04-12 17:00 UTC.
Jamie (AM): Thanks team. Will update after the call. :thumbsup:
